product.title: The Front Office
product.summary: The Track 201 capstone: run a franchise through four decision cycles.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students enter a class code, pick a franchise archetype — contender, young, or rebuilding — and run four cycles of room-based decisions covering trades, the draft lottery, press conferences and random events, moving cap flexibility, roster quality, optionality, trust and tax exposure. They finish by choosing a franchise philosophy and receiving a graded dossier.

facilitation.prep: Teacher issues class codes from the built-in dashboard.

product.technology: single-file HTML (~22,000 lines) with jsPDF for report export

studentDataProfile.notes: Name, class code, quiz scores and metrics persist in browser localStorage under tfr_* keys. No server was observed, so records live only on the device that produced them.

governance.maturityBasis: The most complete capstone in the account, publicly reachable, with a teacher dashboard and PDF and CSV export. No tests, and no student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: GitHub Pages returned 200 on 2026-08-14. Reachability only.
knownBlockers: Teacher records live only in the browser that created them — clearing storage or changing device loses the class.
A 22,000-line single file with no automated tests.
